proof_scope.3301: Defines separated-orbit entropy and proves compatible-metric invariance by uniform continuity. Conjugacy invariance follows from the same comparison.
proof_scope.3302: Defines top entropy on invariant Borel sets and ergodic MME; delegates entropy decomposition and the variational principle to separate atoms.
proof_scope.3303: Complete compactness and upper-semicontinuity proof of existence, including invariance of the limit and selection of an ergodic component. Newhouse upper semicontinuity is cited.
proof_scope.3304: Defines standard Pesin blocks and proves the shifted-block inclusion. Compactness is cited from the block lemma; splitting uniqueness is proved in 3305.
proof_scope.3305: Complete forward/backward bounded-vector proof of splitting uniqueness, with epsilon<chi used in the expansion lower bound.
proof_scope.3306: Defines pointwise, chi-hyperbolic, saddle and stable-index notions. Pesin-block exhaustion of a chi-hyperbolic measure is cited.
proof_scope.3307: States Pesin stable-manifold theorem for r>1 and hyperbolic invariant measures; distinguishes it from the existing uniform theorem. Graph-transform construction remains external.
proof_scope.3308: Complete two-sided Ruelle derivation of lambda1>=h>0>-h>=lambda2 for ergodic surface measures; does not use the area-preserving Pesin equality.
proof_scope.3309: Defines SPR with fixed chi, then arbitrary epsilon, then common threshold/block/mass, then all high-entropy ergodic measures. Proves the uniform-hyperbolic example.
proof_scope.3310: Cites the local quadratic large-deviation bound with positive variance and explicit quantifier order. Conservatively specializes to period one; no uniform moving-threshold result is inferred.
proof_scope.3311: Cites square-root entropy-gap control for positive exponent sum on a single SPR class, and separately the unique-global-MME surface result. Only direct substitution consequences are calculated.
proof_scope.3312: Complete one-dimensional derivative multiplicativity and Birkhoff proof of average-exponent continuity; warns that positive-part integration needs additional sign control.
proof_scope.3313: Cites the report's accessible T3 circle-fibration dichotomy and SPR equivalence. Separately states the C2 closed-connected-three-manifold sufficient condition actually present in BCS v1, retaining bounded center-leaf length and a hyperbolic periodic point.
proof_scope.3314: Defines pressure, equilibrium state and potential-SPR with finite real top pressure. Cites BCS Theorem G only for Holder potentials on a Borel homoclinic class.
proof_scope.3315: Defines unstable-Jacobian potential and reuses the atomic SRB definition 380K; retains sufficient-condition question as open at the report's scope. Does not assert that every hyperbolic SRB measure is SPR.
proof_scope.3316: Defines symmetric asymptotic derivative dilation and proves its limit exists by subadditivity. Cites the strict finite-Cr entropy threshold for global or class SPR; derives impossibility of SPR plus infinitely many ergodic MME at r>1.
proof_scope.330A: Complete positive-block-mass and Oseledets argument for |lambda_i|>=chi; strict chi'-hyperbolicity uses chi'<chi.
proof_scope.330B: Defines positive exponent sum by integral of pointwise positive parts, proves the Jacobian integral identity using Oseledets and dominated convergence, and explains nonergodic cancellation.
proof_scope.330C: Complete subadditive-integral infimum formula and weak upper-semicontinuity proof, using Oseledets as a cited input.
proof_scope.330D: Cites the positive entropy/exponent loss decomposition. Completely derives maximal-entropy exponent continuity, including the subsequence argument and beta=1.
proof_scope.330E: States EH/EC criterion in positive-entropy global or Borel-homoclinic-class setting. Forward implication is C1; converse is retained at C1+. Stable index is constant within each limit, not necessarily across all limits.
proof_scope.330F: Complete deduction of smooth positive-entropy surface SPR from Newhouse, Ruelle, entropy decomposition, exponent continuity and the criterion. The input research theorems remain cited.
proof_scope.330G: Complete neutral-vector obstruction to every Pesin block for Anosov times circle rotation. Positive entropy of the cat map is a standard cited example.
proof_scope.330H: Defines double transverse homoclinic relation and proves equality of stable dimensions. Equivalence relation and periodic representative are cited.
proof_scope.330I: Defines Borel homoclinic representatives, class entropy and period. Existence, separation and measure-class correspondence are cited, not reconstructed.
proof_scope.330J: Defines countable graph shifts and regular part; proves every invariant probability gives full mass to the regular part using the existing Poincare recurrence theorem.
proof_scope.330K: Complete path-modulo-period construction, equality of cyclic masses, nonmixing obstruction, and independence of base vertex.
proof_scope.330L: Defines finite-core symbolic SPR and escape entropy; gives a complete diagonal proof of equivalence with a strict entropy gap. Equivalence to loop growth is cited.
proof_scope.330M: Cites Gurevich variational principle and SPR loop-growth characterization. Gives the renewal generating-function proof of F(R)>1 iff the first-return radius exceeds the loop radius.
proof_scope.330N: Defines Bernoulli times a finite cycle; proves block coding of the pth power, phase obstruction to mixing, and equivalence of total ergodicity with period one in this class.
proof_scope.330O: Cites existence/uniqueness and Bernoulli-up-to-period for finite-entropy irreducible SPR shifts, and the homoclinic-class version. Does not infer these from arbitrary finite-to-one maps alone.
proof_scope.330P: States coding with domain Sigma, finite fibers only on Sigma#, entropy-preserving projection and lifting of chi-hyperbolic ergodic measures. SPR transfer requires coding chi below the SPR constant.
proof_scope.330Q: Cites the global finite-homoclinic-class decomposition; explains its local-product mechanism without calling it a full proof. Fully proves finite-class-to-global SPR combination and derives finiteness of ergodic MME.
proof_scope.330R: Complete h-transform normalization, duality, invariance and L1 contraction calculation under stated spectral eigen-data; full-shift L1=q versus normalized L1=1 check. Existence of eigen-data remains cited.
proof_scope.330S: Complete abstract spectral-gap-to-correlation estimate with explicit continuous embedding into L1; spectrum/radius formula and existence of the SPR Banach space are cited inputs.
proof_scope.330T: Cites exponential mixing for the MME of an SPR class with total ergodicity/period one and Holder norms. Retains the cyclic-component f^p version when p>1.
proof_scope.330U: Cites positive-entropy class equivalence involving an MME, common exponent gap and exponential entrance tails. Explicitly quantifies C after epsilon. Derives the surface simplification from Ruelle.
proof_scope.330V: Complete tail-sum proof that a nonnegative integer entrance time has exponential tails iff some positive exponential moment is finite, and all polynomial moment bounds.
proof_scope.330W: Complete Green-Kubo expansion and absolute-summability limit proof. States the ordinary formula only under summable correlations; does not use it unmodified for period p>1.
proof_scope.330X: Cites zero-variance equivalence with periodic averages and measurable coboundaries for the SPR-class MME. Gives a full telescoping proof only for the additional L2-coboundary case.
proof_scope.330Y: Defines process-level ASIP coupling and completely derives the central limit consequence by distribution-function bounds; treats sigma=0 separately and obtains parameter uniqueness.
proof_scope.330Z: Cites ASIP with SPR class, MME and centered Holder observable, rates gamma in (1/4,1/2). No period-one requirement is added. General quasi-Holder extension is mentioned only as scope of the source.
proof_scope.331C: Defines Holder seminorm/norm and gives the complete exponent-product calculation for pullback by a Holder coding.
proof_scope.331D: States compact continuous variational principle as a standard cited theorem; derives restriction of the supremum to ergodic measures from 331E.
proof_scope.331E: States standard ergodic decomposition and entropy integral formula as cited theorems; fully proves the maximality and support consequences by integrating nonnegative functions.
proof_scope.331F: States Ruelle-Margulis inequality for C1 closed-manifold diffeomorphisms and arbitrary invariant probabilities; records the inverse-time inequality and distinguishes it from the Pesin equality.

normalization_notes: Date 2026-10-19; author{author}; native Forester math wrappers; no raw wiki links or negative thin spaces.
MME means ergodic MME when discussing finiteness. Convex combinations are not counted as additional ergodic MME.
SPR quantifiers: fixed chi; for every epsilon in (0,chi), a common threshold h0, block C and positive mass; then all high-entropy ergodic measures.
Pointwise positive exponent parts are integrated before averaging; same-index hypotheses are stated locally.
Class coding threshold chi is chosen below the SPR exponent constant; finite fibers are restricted to Sigma#.
Probability transfer operator is the normalized h-transform, not the unweighted Ruelle sum.
Exponential mixing retains total ergodicity/period-one; ASIP does not require period one.
Entrance time starts at n=0, inf empty=+infinity; C is quantified after epsilon.
Finite-Cr threshold uses the symmetric asymptotic derivative dilation from BCS (1.2), not an ambiguously named single-step Lipschitz exponent.

normalization_notes: Every atom has local objects and assumptions. Smooth means C-infinity unless an explicit finite regularity is stated. C1-small controls the topology of closeness, not the differentiability class of the perturbed maps.

Partial hyperbolicity uses unit tangent vectors and point-dependent bounds. The center can contract or expand weakly; it need not integrate. Strong leaves pass through every point, not just periodic points.

Essential accessibility uses measurable unions of entire accessibility classes having zero or full volume. A full-measure single class is sufficient, not the definition; density of all classes alone is not equated with it.
Totally partially hyperbolic means one common center and a dense set of parameters. For semisimple actions the Anosov center is tangent to C_G(A)-orbits, not merely A-orbits.
Coarse Lyapunov classes use positive proportionality. Walls are kernels of nonzero forms; the zero exponent does not define a wall. Expansion has positive exponent in the explicit SL3 calculation.
Super-accessibility asks for an accessible element on each wall. GHR asks for a dense orbit of the wall subgroup; it does not mean that every wall element has a dense orbit.
Oseledets conformality is exact e^{chi(a)} norm scaling, including isometry on the zero space. Measurable and continuous versions are separated, as required by DSVX Theorems 2.18 and 2.16.

Every simple semisimple factor has real rank at least two; total rank alone is insufficient. Connected linear groups are the stated scope of 340S. Finite-cover lifting and smooth conjugacy are retained.
The double quotient in 340D uses q(G) commuting with K and explicitly takes a free compact quotient for a smooth manifold. The source model and its cover construction are not replaced by a torus.
Ordinary K definition is reused from 00S5, not 00A2. 340V is solely the elementary completely-positive-entropy-implies-ergodicity consequence.
Centralizers here use pointwise smooth equality. 00WO is the distinct measure-mod-zero centralizer. Scanner matches of symmetry-group wording to permutation group 00DC were rejected.
340K is a local holonomy naturality/equivariance proposition to image transversals, not unconditional commutation on one fixed transversal. General holonomy terminology is reused from sibling 3503.
Affine commutation on the torus is a lattice congruence; exactly commuting real lifts define the zero-equation parameter space T(A,B). Its own Lebesgue measure is used in 3418.

DFS primary locked/unlocked definition is broader than the stable-identity presentation in the restricted report Theorem 6.1: it also permits genuinely parabolic rank-one affine factors. 3418 explicitly cites the primary Theorem A version.
Almost every affine parameter, joint-action ergodicity, and every sufficiently small normalized perturbation of a selected KAM-rigid action are separate quantifiers.
No diagram is added: the root and affine identities are clearer as explicit formulas and complete calculations. No existing foundation or shared registry was rewritten.

proof_scope.350A: Cites Sullivan's stability classification only for the report's full simple-pole Riccati family with 2g-2+n>0. Faithfulness and the full, not peripheral-constrained, deformation family are explicit.
proof_scope.350B: Gives the complete inverse geometric-series and commutator norm estimate. It does not infer dense generation from smallness alone.
proof_scope.350C: Proves extension of a dense-action conjugacy to an inclusion of the Möbius group, and proves equality by sharp three-transitivity. The final continuous automorphism classification and robust dense-image existence remain cited inputs.
proof_scope.350D: Defines the multiplicity-bearing trace-square divisor, proves that identity monodromy can occur in codimension one, and explains Poincare-Lelong at smooth support points. The general singular-divisor formula is cited.
proof_scope.350E: Defines the fixed-surface Brownian process through its heat kernel and Laplace-Beltrami generator; cites almost-sure exponent existence. Proves conjugacy/norm independence and the time-rescaling factor.
proof_scope.350F: Cites the Brownian exponent continuity, plurisubharmonicity and bifurcation-support theorem with connected parameter manifold, nontrivial family, a faithful parameter and non-elementarity at every parameter; compact base fixed.
proof_scope.350G: Cites the exact independent length-counting random primitive closed-geodesic theorem, the summability condition, and 1/(2 length) normalization. The deep L1-potential convergence is not proved locally.
proof_scope.350H: Records the survey's unmarked-base asymptotic-current questions, simple-loop density conjecture and peripheral-loxodromic obstruction; no extension theorem is asserted.
proof_scope.350I: Defines the derived series locally and cites Shcherbakov rigidity for finitely generated nonsolvable holomorphic germ groups. No global surface rigidity is deduced from it alone.
proof_scope.350J: Cites Nakai's local minimal/ergodic alternative and describes the finite sectors explicitly. Renormalization and fixed-domain flow approximation are explained as research inputs, not a complete proof.
proof_scope.350K: Defines local density, proves orbit density and exclusion of a continuous positive transverse Hermitian metric using Cauchy derivative convergence. Belliart-Liousse-Loray local density in Nakai sectors is cited.
proof_scope.350L: Cites the full-measure invariant-line Ilyashenko/Hudai-Verenov theorem, with affine conjugacy and the restricted parameter family. Global continuation of local rigidity is not reconstructed.
proof_scope.350M: Cites Loray-Rebelo Theorem A on a nonempty Euclidean-open fixed-degree subset, with minimality, measurable saturated-set ergodicity and near-identity topological rigidity. Does not assert Zariski openness.
proof_scope.350N: Defines directed positive dd^c-closed currents, verifies the weighted-harmonic-plaque example by integration by parts, and distinguishes dd^c-closed from d-closed. General flow-box disintegration is cited.
proof_scope.350O: Fully derives the weighted-disc representation, unit mass, Jensen boundary identity and dd^c boundary term. Harmonicity of limits is conditional on characteristic mass tending to infinity; that growth input is cited.
proof_scope.350P: Cites Dinh-Sibony Theorem 1.1 with only hyperbolic singularities and exactly one invariant algebraic curve, a line. Derives the vanishing mass on compact sets off the line; does not claim unaveraged disc convergence.
proof_scope.350Q: States the infinite-mass harmonic-current conjecture on the open complement of an ample nodal invariant curve with all other leaves dense and hyperbolic singularities. Recurrence and stopped random-germ processes remain questions.
proof_scope.350R: Preserves the report's local-density and minimality-closure questions and separates a persistent multiplier-one germ from an actual parameter bifurcation by explicit examples.
proof_scope.350S: Fully proves the divergence-free radial gauge using Euler's homogeneous identity; does not infer nonvanishing of the resulting representative.
proof_scope.350T: Fully counts homogeneous coefficients, radial directions and scalar projectivization; subtracts the projective-group dimension only on finite-stabilizer loci.
proof_scope.350U: Fully counts d^2+d+1 projective singularities, excludes zero coordinates, and verifies the unitary diagonal cyclic symmetry and its transitivity.
proof_scope.350V: Fully diagonalizes the cyclic degree-one field and computes the actual affine eigenvalue differences. Degree-one structural stability is attributed to the survey's linear criterion.
proof_scope.350W: Fully verifies the elliptic-curve-valued first integral, its logarithmic periods, submersion property, connected fibres and fibre type C rather than the disc.
proof_scope.350X: Fully computes the leafwise gradient in complex-coordinate real-velocity convention, verifies homogeneity and descent, and identifies the two disjoint zero loci.
proof_scope.350Y: Fully computes leafwise second derivatives and the real Hessian eigenvalue signs, obtaining the strict PB inequality and identifying the degenerate equality case.
proof_scope.350Z: Fully computes every Jouanolou singularity's eigenvalues and the source sign for the auxiliary real field using unitary transitivity, verifying PS for all d>=1.

remaining_branches: Deep proofs remain external: Sullivan representation stability, Shcherbakov/Nakai/Belliart-Liousse-Loray pseudogroup results, Ilyashenko and Loray-Rebelo realization/global rigidity, Deroin-Dujardin probabilistic current theory, Dinh-Sibony density-of-currents uniqueness, and Alvarez-Deroin hyperbolic gluing/computer-assisted inequality.

The report's ample normal-crossing invariant-divisor extension by Gomez-Mont and Ortiz-Bobadilla is contextual background, not a newly stated standalone theorem with independently checked original genericity hypotheses. Its original article was not read; no arbitrary-surface full-moduli Zariski-open conclusion is asserted.

Full Fatou-Julia equivalence for arbitrary foliations, classification of minimal general-type foliation moduli and current construction on varying-base/singular Riccati spaces are not reconstructed. J2 uses the specific basin identification proved in AD.

The post-survey all-degree preprint is acknowledged without independent proof validation. Cantor total disconnectedness, zero transverse measure and the genus-three covering conjecture are not promoted to theorems.
The report's exceptional-minimal-set degree range contains inconsistent >=5 versus <=5 wording; no degree-range theorem or accumulation-at-every-singularity inference is imported.
No exhaustive literature review after the identified 2026-09-28 preprint is claimed.
normalization_notes: 350V derives the actual J1 affine eigenvalues omega-1 and omega^2-1. The report's printed 2 +/- i sqrt(3) pair is not copied. 350W uses b log x - a log y and proves fibre type C, not disc.
350G fixes the original DD matrix operator norm and generator Delta, hence 1/(2 length) for trace-square divisors. This is not silently identified with the report's compressed 1/t parabolic formula.
Z(gamma,4) includes identity monodromy and multiplicities. Removing identity relations can change a divisor and is not justified.
Loxodromic openness means ordinary topology; the elliptic trace interval is not treated as a complex algebraic locus.
Dinh-Sibony's theorem uses all singularities hyperbolic and a unique invariant algebraic line, not merely nondegenerate singularities.
350N/350O use d^c=i/(2pi)(barpartial-partial), so dd^c log|z|=delta_0 and dd^c log^+(r/|z|)=nu_r-delta_0.

350X defines the real field by its complex coordinate velocity. Compared with the half-real-part convention in AD, any constant positive time rescaling leaves PB, PS, basins and the stability criterion unchanged.
General Hermitian metrics are explicitly distinguished from ambient Kahler closedness. 0B8I already defines both concepts.
3501 and 3519 split stability and rigidity. The latter only implies bifurcation when genuinely non-equivalent nearby moduli exist.
All-degree status is date/version specific: survey conjecture versus Gehlawat2609v1 claims. The packet and reference distinguish licensing from mathematical validation.
